build_LRAModel: build an LRA model instance with a specified encoder type and task for long-range arena benchmarks
build_LRAEncoder: build an LRA encoder that wraps transformer, luna, lstm, flash, or mega encoder backends
run_LRAModel_forward: run the LRAModel forward pass to compute sentence-level classification logits from input tokens
configure_base_architecture: configure the base LRA architecture with default hyperparameters for dropout, dimensions, and classifier settings
configure_mega_lra_architecture: configure a MEGA-based LRA architecture preset for listop, imdb, aan, cifar10, or pf32 tasks
